title: 4BR Rental in Rosemary Beach with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Stay at Julia's Cottage, a 4BR, 4.5BA Rosemary Beach rental with private beach access, free beach cruiser bikes, and close to the Cabana Pool. Sleeps 4.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• Apple TV, Harmony Elite Remote in Living Room• 4 Free Beach Cruiser Bikes• Bedding: 3 Kings | 4 Fulls• Kitchen with Stainless Steel Wolf/Sub-zero Appliances• Courtyard Plenty of Space for Outdoor Dining• High-Speed Mesh Network WIFI Internet• Garage for 1 Car and Parking pad for 1 carHigh style and great taste combine to make Julia’s Cottage one of the hippest and most fun homes on the park side of Rosemary Beach. Completely renovated in 2019/2020, this four bedroom, four-and-a-half bath stunner is ready for your best-ever vacation with family and friends.Reminiscent of a casita on the Moroccan seaside, the home’s landmark pointed arches frame a wraparound first-floor porch, where you can relax with a cocktail while walkers and bikers pass by the beach boardwalk adjacent to this home.The newly expanded interior, designed by nationally acclaimed Erika McPherson Powell of Urban Grace Interiors, exudes magazine-worthy luxury and comfort.Julia’s open concept living room is furnished with a double chaise sofa, a couch and six chairs/stools surrounding an expansive coffee table and 65” flat screen TV. Play cards, relax or work on a puzzle while you watch football!The gorgeous chefs’ kitchen is every cook’s dream with a Viking range/stove, bacon grill and Sub Zero refrigerator. Just outside the kitchen is a brand new Weber Genesis II gas grill. Dine inside at the table or al fresco under the pergola!The first floor bunk room, featuring four full beds this room is sure to delight children from ages 2 to 102. Surrounded by whimsical but sophisticated fish wallpaper, giving the bunk room a cozy and fun underwater feel. The bunk bathroom features full bathroom just outside the room.Rounding out the first floor is a scullery that connects to the kitchen via a “hidden” door. There you will find a mudroom with ample storage, new large capacity washer and dryer, pantry and a powder bathroom.On the second floor, three bedrooms with extra comfortable king size beds feature en suite baths.The first master suite has a generously sized dual head shower and double sink vanity; a second master suite is a brand new addition to the house and features large windows that fill the room with light and sunshine.A third bedroom — also with a king bed — has an en suite bathroom with a bathtub/shower combo. Each room has its own entertainment center, complete with a television and cable TV. A wraparound second-floor deck is accessible by two of the bedrooms.Julia's Cottage is located a short walk from the St. Augustine Green, Butterfly Park and the Cabana Pool. Need a little more space? Check out the Julia Carriage House, located above the garage in the courtyard. Rents separately.
